description: A Java class implementing a stream processor 'Filter' that filters messages by type and predicate using Akka Streams. It provides methods to create filtering graph stages based on message class and predicate, multiplexing messages via mapping functions or Eithers, and constructs for stream processing logic.

classes.name: Filter
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for creating filter and multiplexing streams using Akka Streams.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a graph stage that filters messages based on class type and a predicate.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a graph stage that filters messages based solely on class type, with no additional predicate.

methods.name: multiplexBy
methods.description: Creates a graph that multiplexes messages by applying a partial function mapper to produce accepted messages.

methods.name: multiplexByEither
methods.description: Creates a graph that multiplexes messages based on an Either mapper, separating accepted and rejected messages.

methods.name: multiplexByEitherFlow
methods.description: Creates a graph from a flow that produces an Either of accepted and rejected messages for multiplexing.
